subject: [PATCH 1/1] mm/zswap: enable static key after runtime pool recovery

reviews.author: Yosry Ahmed
reviews.summary: Reviewer Yosry Ahmed requested that Usama Arif send the zswap patches independently of the PMD swap series, specifically as a standalone fix for an issue reported by Sashiko
reviews.raw_body:
Would you be able to send the zswap bits only as a standalone (and
hopefully backportable) fix to the issue Sashiko surfaced?

2026-09-07.patch_summary: This patch enables a static key after runtime pool recovery in the mm/zswap module. The static key is used to track whether zswap is present or not, and this information is used to make decisions about large-folio loads and high-order swap cache allocations. The patch adds a new function zswap_is_present() that checks if zswap is present for a given swp_entry_t and unsigned int nr. This function is used in the PMD swap-entry consumers to determine whether to attempt PMD-order swapin or not. The patch also updates several functions in mm/zswap.c to use this new information. Overall, the patch improves the handling of large-folio loads and high-order swap cache allocations by zswap.
